hidden: Mucosa of uterine tube (lamina propria folds)

hidden: Mucosa of uterine tube (lamina propria folds)
Follicle - cellular oocyte interface.note: Follow oocyte → acellular zona → corona cells → cumulus attachment → mural granulosa, retaining antral and thecal context. Ovarian specimen about 2.5x; follicles/corpora and sampled cells separately enlarged; comparative field, not one measured human section. Hide antral fluid locator, retain physical wall and open space. Cell/nucleus profiles are sampled; enlarged zona is acellular, not an epithelial ring.

Ampulla - folded common lumen.note: Orient fold cores, epithelium, muscle and one shared open lumen. Ampulla nominally about 20–30x; cell/cilium patch separately enlarged and sampled; ratio and counts are representative. Ciliated and secretory cell identity is representative, not a cellular census. Fold projections are continuous mucosal folds, not independent tubes. Do not let close patch framing remove all fold/core/lumen cues.

Ampulla - ciliated and secretory cells.note: Show lumen-facing cilia on a restrained representative epithelial patch attached to the fold core. Ampulla nominally about 20–30x; cell/cilium patch separately enlarged and sampled; ratio and counts are representative. Ciliated and secretory cell identity is representative, not a cellular census. Fold projections are continuous mucosal folds, not independent tubes. Do not let close patch framing remove all fold/core/lumen cues.

hidden: Mucosa of uterine tube (lamina propria folds)
Endometrium - intact tissue context.note: Orient myometrium, basalis and functionalis with gland/stromal relationships. Endometrium nominally about 20–30x; sampled cellular/glandular/vascular routes; secretory tissue and later implantation form a staged composite. Secretory tissue comparison plus late-week-2 conceptus is not one exactly timed histological slice. Varied representative artery paths and matching recipient channels are source-implemented but unbuilt. Scope: Myometrium (inner layer), Stratum basalis (basal layer), Stratum functionalis (functional layer), Uterine surface epithelium, Spiral arteries and Straight (basal) arteries. Exact unchanged six-part precursor reproduction and early complete vessel/host checks must pass before continued construction. Solid arterial markers do not demonstrate blood lumens or perfusion coverage. Stromal material allocation source correction is implemented but unbuilt; stromal cells must be readable in context after build and review.

Development - preimplantation sequence.note: Keep secondary oocyte, paired pronuclei, cleavage, morula and pre-hatching blastocyst distinct. Early embryo series nominally about 80x; displayed 10.8 mm corresponds nominally to about 135 micrometres. Fine structures separately enlarged; no exact size/time inference. hidden: Mucosa of uterine tube (lamina propria folds)
Blastocyst - pre-hatching cavity.note: Distinguish trophoblast wall, one-sided inner cell mass and blastocoel space. Early embryo series nominally about 80x; displayed 10.8 mm corresponds nominally to about 135 micrometres. Fine structures separately enlarged; no exact size/time inference. Blastocele locator hidden by default. Zona escape precedes attachment; hatching is explained, not demonstrated by current geometry. Representative cells and section opening disclosed.

hidden: Mucosa of uterine tube (lamina propria folds)
Conceptus - late week 2 bilaminar.note: Separate later implanted bilaminar conceptus from initial attachment and preimplantation blastocyst. Endometrium nominally about 20–30x; sampled cellular/glandular/vascular routes; secretory tissue and later implantation form a staged composite. Epiblast and hypoblast are primary labels. Hypoblast is not definitive embryonic endoderm; definitive germ-layer formation during gastrulation is not represented here. Trophoblast sublayers and extraembryonic mesoderm unresolved. Amniotic/chorionic cavity locators hidden. Previous failed candidate had contact speckling; source interface correction is implemented but unbuilt and requires new independent review.

Comparative atlas - mixed scales.note: Optional navigation map after organ orientation. Pelvis at life size (1 unit = 100 mm; the uterus ~7.5 cm long). The breast is shown at about 0.8x; the ovary specimen ~2.5x (follicles and corpora enlarged for clarity), the ampulla section and endometrium ~20-30x, and the early embryos nominally ~80x (10.8 mm displayed diameter represents about 135 micrometres); sperm and other fine details use separate teaching enlargement. Detached enlarged specimens are comparisons, not neighboring anatomy. Global physical ruler disabled; pelvis reference isolated. Do not use global slider midpoint as median pelvis section.
